# transcription: the RFC states occurrences as prose (month names
#          "(YYYY 9:00 AM EDT)" year marker). expectedDates is that notation expanded to concrete
#          dates. Self-check: every COUNT=n rule expands to exactly n dates
#          is a real calendar date. Verified 2026-08-05: 0 problems over 39 examples.
# occurrence time-of-day equals the DTSTART time except where flagged time-expansion.
# flags: elided        = the RFC abbreviates the list with "..."; not fully enumerable
#        utc-until     = UNTIL is UTC-valued against a zoned DTSTART
#        sub-daily     = FREQ is HOURLY/MINUTELY/SECONDLY (not enumerated by this library)
#        time-expansion= BYHOUR/BYMINUTE/BYSECOND expands within the day
